say:4:1511004001:0.text: Though there are no visible words or glyphs, you sense ancient energy in the chains. You try interpreting the symbols with magic.
say:4:1511004001:0.source_cn: 神力凝结而成的锁链上并没有具象的、可以称之为文字的符号...
say:4:1511004001:0.male: Though there are no visible words or glyphs, you sense ancient energy in the chains. You try interpreting the symbols with magic.
say:4:1511004001:0.female: Though there are no visible words or glyphs, you sense ancient energy in the chains. You try interpreting the symbols with magic.

say:5:1511004002:0.text: The Wedge of Spirit - the soul that shapes the world.
say:5:1511004002:0.source_cn: 精神之楔——无形之灵塑造世界。

say:9:1511004003:0.text: The Wedge of Matter - the solid body that forms the land.
say:9:1511004003:0.source_cn: 物质之楔——坚实之躯构建大陆。

say:13:1511004004:0.text: The Wedge of Power - the force that governs all.
say:13:1511004004:0.source_cn: 权能之楔——超越之力掌控万物。

narration:17:1501101403:0.text: The Wedge of Power is formed from wind magic.
narration:17:1501101403:0.source_cn: 权能之楔，由风系魔法构成。

narration:18:1501101403:0.text: The Wedge of Power is formed from wind magic.
narration:18:1501101403:0.source_cn: 权能之楔，由风系魔法构成。

narration:19:1501101402:0.text: The Wedge of Spirit is formed from fire magic.
narration:19:1501101402:0.source_cn: 精神之楔，由火系魔法构成。

narration:20:15011014:0.text: The Wedge of Matter is formed from earth magic.
narration:20:15011014:0.source_cn: 物质之楔，由土系魔法构成。
